mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (id, payload) VALUES (#{id, javaType=java.util.UUID}, #{payload}::jsonb)
mapper.select: SELECT id, payload::text AS payload, created_at, published_at, attempts FROM outbox_event WHERE published_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET published_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id, javaType=java.util.UUID} AND published_at IS NULL
UPDATE outbox_event SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id, javaType=java.util.UUID} AND published_at IS NULL
